Reference / cli/arguments

cli/arguments#

The process's arguments, as bytes or text.

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

let arguments = ProcessArguments().strings();      // without the program name
ProcessArguments().first();                        // the first argument's bytes

Description#

The process's arguments, as bytes or text.

Arguments are the bytes the system passed, never shell text. At most 4096 arguments and 1 MiB are read by default.

Public API#

object ProcessArguments#

object ProcessArguments does Sequencing<@byte>, Iterating<@byte>

Explicit argv bytes; never shell text. The host supplies the already split sequence. Bounded snapshots can outlive a borrowed argument provider.
